component.name: Tributary
component.summary: A fast, friendly git client, with first-class Git LFS, locks and art diffs

description.p: A commit graph that's a pleasure to read, Undo for almost everything, and pull requests in the app, with first-class big files too: Git LFS, locks, and art you can actually see in a diff.

ul.li: A colourful commit graph, with branches, remote branches, tags and stashes labelled, and search by message, author, file or code.
Diffs coloured by syntax, and staging whole files, hunks or single lines.
Merge, rebase, cherry-pick, revert and interactive rebase, with conflicts resolved in the app.
Pull and merge requests on GitHub and GitLab: review, comment and merge, with their checks.
Undo for almost everything, and backups of branches before they're rewritten or deleted.
Git LFS downloads with progress, locks, and textures, models and sounds shown as what they are.

description.p: Tributary uses the computer's own git (and Git LFS, for repositories that use it), with its settings, credentials and SSH keys, so install git first.

screenshot.caption: A repository's commit graph, its branches and a commit's changes
A pull request with its reviews and checks
Resolving a merge conflict in the app

description.p: Tabs go where you drag them, uncommitted changes can be shown in their folders, and Tributary comes to Linux.
